paragraphs: Rabbi Zeiri of Deyhavot: Taanit 7b, he spoke to Ravina. Rashi reads,“Mar Zeiri of Deyhavot told Ravina,”since unqualified Zeiri was among the early sages and Ravina at the end of the teaching period; they did not see one another.
